method.purpose: Independent candidate oracle for issue #6, prepared before adapters; records remain pending human audit.
method.scope: Read only AGENTS.md and captures.json, rightsinfo.json, *.revision.json and *.rendered.json in tests/fixtures/ingest/pages. No wikitext captures, adapter code, tests or other worktrees were read. No network access or file writes occurred.
method.extraction: Enumerated selections from rendered HTML target sections in display order. Positions are one-based selection positions. Preserved displayed spelling and case. Used NBR Best Film rank 1 and null ranks for alphabetical non-winners; used explicit Sight and Sound li value ranks. Repeated ranks share stable rank-N tie identifiers.
method.exclusions: Ignored image captions, narrative film mentions, references, navigation, embedded categories and empty list elements.
method.verification: For all four pages, rendered response revision, title and page ID match revision evidence and manifest. Revision and rendered file byte counts and SHA-256 hashes match captures.json. All manifest license declarations match rightsinfo.json. Unread wikitext captures were not verified.

rights_limits.limits: Verified consistency of local declarations only. Reuse must preserve applicable attribution, license and share-alike obligations. This declaration does not establish rights to original NBR/BFI publications, referenced material or embedded images; those rights were not verified.

method.validation_limits: Local Wikipedia rendered evidence only; no original-source factual validation, independent upstream corroboration, film identity resolution or human audit.
